skill.summary: Cloud-based editor-ai-for-business tool that handles editing corporate and marketing videos quickly without a professional editor. Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editor AI for Business.
- Quickly edit and export corporate and marketing videos via a cloud-based tool—no professional editing skills required.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and describe desired edits to receive a 1080p MP4 output in 1–2 minutes.
- Built-in workflows include quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement, supporting both uploads and text-based instructions.
- Automatic handling of backend connection, session creation, and token management (including free starter tokens for new users).
- Supports major video, image, and audio formats, with clear guidance and error handling for file size, format, and account issues.
